Done. The code compiles cleanly and behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged.

## What I did

I prepared two seams — one per touchpoint the change will rewrite — without implementing any of the fiscal-year behavior itself.

**`Owner.java` — isolated the tenure rule out of `membershipPoints`.** The date-derived tenure check was inlined among the four point contributions. I extracted it into a focused private static helper:

```java
private static boolean hasTenureBonus(LocalDate registrationDate) {
    return registrationDate != null
        && java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(registrationDate, LocalDate.now()) > 365;
